runtime: WSLc 3.0.5.0; no pull; network none; ephemeral; source read-only bind; evidence writable bind; private tmpfs /tmp; memory cap warning retained.
purpose: Isolate X server XTEST auto-repeat behavior from the standard MCP caller and delayed-request harness.
probe: Create a focused X window; apply baseline/global-off/per-key-A-off mode; issue exactly one synthetic A KeyPress; hold for 1200 ms; issue one KeyRelease; record all received A events and independent post-release keymap.
attempts: one fresh WSLc container per condition and interpreter; six total; no retry
decision_rule: Record actual KeyPress/KeyRelease counts, event timestamps, keyboard-control readback and post-release independent keymap. Compare repeat settings directly. This is a synthetic server control only; no caller/product acceptance.
limits: No MCP/runtime caller, no delayed XTEST request, no application task effect, no live GUI, no provider/model call.
